title: ship has no sanctioned path to push attested-but-stranded commits — GIT_PUSH_REJECTED recovery dead-ends at 'no staged changes; nothing to ship'
summary: Reproduced live 2026-08-02 on the runtime plane. Sequence: (1) evolve ship creates commit 16c8f8bc (commit-gate attested d4799eb2) but origin/main had moved (#396) -> GIT_PUSH_REJECTED, 'local commit preserved... reconcile with evolve sync-main'; (2) sync-main merges origin in (merge ff09b899), tree now CLEAN and 2 attested commits ahead; (3) re-running ship: 'no staged changes; nothing to ship' — and bare git push is (correctly) guard-denied. The recovery the ship error prescribes cannot complete through any sanctioned command. Workaround that resolved it: file the next legitimate inbox change and let that ship carry the stranded commits — works at a batch boundary but is a coincidence of having pending bookkeeping, not a path. Fix shape: ship detects clean-tree-but-ahead-of-origin where every local commit is either commit-gate attested, a cycle ship, or a sync-main merge of such — and completes the push under the same atomic-ship verifications (prefix gate, SELF_SHA, ledger), refusing if ANY unattested commit is in the ahead set. NOT a bypass: it extends attestation checking to the push-only case.
acceptance: RED: reproduce the strand in a fixture repo (ship -> reject -> sync-main -> ship reports nothing to ship while ahead>0)
ship (or a dedicated subcommand) pushes an all-attested ahead set; refuses with a named error if any ahead commit lacks provenance
the GIT_PUSH_REJECTED error text names the completing command instead of dead-ending at sync-main
